desc: Wilson Combat Custom Pistols are hand built by master pistolsmiths with the finest modern materials and parts machined from forgings and billet steel. The Wilson Combat Professional Elite is an ultimate carry gun. It has a full size 1911 grip frame and shorter compact slide for excellent concealability. This fast handling custom pistol has been enhanced with custom upgrades to enhance its already high performance. It features a beavertail grip safety and hammer, carry cuts, serrated slide top, countersunk slide stop, round butt, flush cut reverse crown, black cherry grips with pewter medallion and Wilson's Armor-Tough black finish.
